attributes.name: link list icon/bullet treatment
attributes.definition: Whether lists of links (footer/link lists, social links) use icons or bullets as markers.

values.definition: Links are text only, with no icons, bullets or other markers.
Links are accompanied by icons or bullet markers.
No such link lists on the page.

attributes.name: social links presentation
attributes.definition: How social media links are rendered.

values.definition: Social links are plain text labels with no icons.
Social links are rendered as icons (SVG or font icons).
No social links on the page.

attributes.name: main navigation style
attributes.definition: Visual treatment of the primary navigation links.

values.definition: Nav is a simple row of text links without dropdown arrows or active-state highlight.
Nav has dropdown indicators, active highlight, buttons or pills.
Another navigation treatment, such as hamburger or sidebar.

attributes.name: main navigation placement
attributes.definition: Where the primary navigation sits relative to the logo/header.

values.definition: Nav links in one horizontal row aligned right beside the logo.
Nav is centered or on a separate row below the logo.
Another placement such as sidebar or hidden menu.
